title: Vivacious Cloak
summary: Gain 8 temporary HP on a qualifying spell cast while Threatened.

fields.Arcane Vivaciousness: Cast a spell while in range of a melee enemy that imposes Threatened. Gain 8 temporary HP even if your attack misses or targets pass their saving throws. A nearby enemy wielding a ranged weapon does not qualify by proximity alone.
fields.Acquisition: Locked Traveller’s Chest in the southeast corner of the Grand Mausoleum.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
